div.div: 5 تجشّأ , (S,) inf. n. تَجَشُّؤٌ; (S, Mgh, K; [in the CK, التَّجَشُّ is erroneously put for التَّجَشُّؤُ;]) or تَجَشَّى, inf. n. تَجَشٍّ; (Msb;) and ↓ جشّأ , (S,) inf. n. تَجْشِئَةٌ; (S, K;) both signify alike; (S;) He eructed, or belched; i. e., emitted a sound accompanied with wind, from his mouth, on an occasion of satiation of the stomach, (Mgh, Msb,) intentionally: (Mgh:) or it (the stomach) emitted wind (K, TA) on an occasion of its impletion with food or drink. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
